raw_text: India has raised concerns over the docking of two Chinese PLA Navy warships at Sri Lanka's Hambantota Port, a strategic deep-water facility built and operated by Chinese companies on a 99-year lease. A Type 054A guided-missile frigate and an auxiliary vessel arrived for a five-day goodwill visit. Indian defence sources said the visit is part of China's strategy to establish a persistent naval presence in the Indian Ocean Region. New Delhi is monitoring the visit closely through naval intelligence assets deployed in the southern Indian Ocean.
clean_text: India concerned about PLAN warships at Hambantota, Chinese-operated port on 99-year lease. Type 054A frigate on 5-day visit. India monitoring through naval intelligence.
